lands.name: Hearthvale Fields
lands.blurb: Golden farmland and sleepy villages. Home.

lands.name: The King's Road
lands.blurb: A wide paved road past castles and toll gates. Safe, slow, full of guards.

lands.name: Shellback
lands.blurb: A whole city built on the back of a sleeping giant turtle, wading across the Glass Sea.

lands.name: Silverlake Shore
lands.blurb: Still silver lakes, reed boats and quiet fishing villages.

lands.name: Silverleaf Wood
lands.blurb: An ancient elf forest of white trees and singing leaves.

lands.name: Whisperwood
lands.blurb: A dark, tangled forest where the trees whisper your name. Fast, if you don't get lost.

lands.name: Frostgiant Vale
lands.blurb: A frozen valley of ice cliffs where giants sleep under the snow.

lands.name: The Grimfang Hills
lands.blurb: Rocky hills riddled with goblin tunnels. The quickest way, and the rudest.

lands.name: The Ironroot Mountains
lands.blurb: High passes and the great stone gates of the dwarf kingdom.

lands.name: Glowcap Hollow
lands.blurb: A forest of giant glowing mushrooms. Everything here is a little bit odd.

lands.name: Mirewisp Fen
lands.blurb: A misty swamp of floating lights. Follow the wrong one and you'll never leave.

lands.name: The Skyshard Isles
lands.blurb: Islands of rock floating in the sky, joined by rope bridges and wind.

lands.name: The Ashen Steps
lands.blurb: Black stone stairs up the side of the volcano to Ember Peak.

stops.name: The Old Mill
stops.intro: The old mill at the edge of Hearthvale creaks in the wind. Miller Bram waves from the doorway with flour on his nose. Sacks of grain lean against the wall, the water wheel is stuck, and a huge millstone sits in the yard.

look.text: A round, cheerful man covered in flour. He keeps glancing at the stuck water wheel.

talk.text: Bram: "Taking that egg to Ember Peak? Brave or barmy, can't tell which. If you can fix my wheel I'll make it worth your while. Oh, and tell the mouse rent's due."
talk.after: Bram: "Still here? That wheel won't fix itself!"

talk.text: Bram: "Best wheel in Hearthvale again! Safe travels, and mind the dark woods."

use.text: Bram gobbles the honey cake and hands you a sack of oats in return.

look.text: One paddle is jammed against a rock. A good knock would free it.

use.text: CLONK! The paddle springs loose and the wheel turns. Bram whoops and gives you two sacks of flour.
You loop the rope round the paddle and everyone pulls. With a groan it frees! Bram gives you a sack of flour.

cast.text: The rock lifts out of the water and the wheel spins free. Bram stares at you. Then he gives you flour.

look.text: A huge round millstone. Scratched into its edge: "Under me sleeps the first word."

take.text: Even with everyone pulling, it doesn't budge.

use.text: You loop the rope and heave. The millstone rolls aside. Underneath is a flat stone carved with a curling flame rune and the letters KAEL.

cast.text: The millstone floats up like a leaf. Underneath is a flat stone carved with a flame rune and the letters KAEL.

look.text: A tiny door in the wall with a tiny sign: PIP'S. Something squeaks inside.

talk.text: A tiny voice squeaks. You can't understand mouse.

cast.text: Now you understand mouse! Pip says: "Say my name nicely and I might share a secret."

look.text: Sacks of grain and flour, stacked high.

take.text: Bram nods. "Take one for the road."
take.after: Bram gives you a look. One sack is plenty.

secrets.text: "Ooh, manners!" Pip scurries out and drops a tiny silver bell at your feet. "Found it in the river. Ring it if you're ever lost."

stops.name: Brightwall Castle Town
stops.intro: Brightwall is all flags, bells and busy streets under a white castle. There's a market, a statue of the old king, a guard captain eyeing your cart, and a wizard's tower leaning slightly to the left.

look.text: A tall woman in polished armour, looking at your cart like it owes her money.

talk.text: Captain Rook: "You've been good to my people on the road. Here, a pass for the gates ahead."
Captain Rook: "Grey riders were asking about a dragon egg. If you've got one... keep it hidden. The Baron pays well and asks no questions."

look.text: King Aldric the Kind, holding a stone egg. On the base: "The second word is carved where kings look." The statue's eyes look up at the crown.

use.text: You climb up to the stone crown. Inside, a small rune stone: one side reads RA, the other TH.

cast.text: You float up to the statue's crown. Inside is a rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

look.text: A crooked tower. A sign: "Wizard Quill. Spells taught. Knock first. NO DRAGONS."

talk.text: Wizard Quill pokes his head out. "An egg? Eek. Fine. I'll teach you to mend things, for 10 gold."

look.text: A small wizard with a huge beard and ink on his fingers.

talk.text: Quill takes 10 gold and taps your forehead. "Mend! There. Try not to break anything I can't fix."
Quill: "Mending lessons are 10 gold. I don't do discounts. Or dragons."

look.text: Coins glitter at the bottom of a fountain carved with fish.

use.text: You ring the silver bell over the water. A fish made of light jumps out and drops a coin purse at your feet!

take.text: You fish out a few coins. A passing grandma tuts loudly.

secrets.text: You whisper the old king's name. The statue's stone egg cracks open: inside is a warm red stone that never cools.

stops.name: Shellback City
stops.intro: Houses, bridges and lanterns cover the turtle's shell like moss. The whole city gently rocks as the turtle wades. There's a market, a harbour master, a tea shop, and an enormous sleepy eye at the edge of the shell.

look.text: An eye as big as a house blinks very slowly. The turtle is called Old Shell, and she is over three thousand years old.

talk.text: The eye blinks. Very slowly. You wait. It blinks again.

cast.text: Old Shell rumbles: "Little egg... I remember the dragons. Keep her warm, little ones." A warm wind wraps around the egg.

look.text: A bearded fox-folk sailor with a spyglass and a parrot that's actually a small lizard.

talk.text: "Need a shortcut? The turtle passes near the far shore tonight. Jump off at the right moment and you'll save days. For 8 gold I'll tell you when."

use.text: He bites the goblin coin, grins, and shows you the jumping spot. You save a lot of road.

look.text: A tiny tea shop that smells of honey and smoke. A sign says FREE TEA FOR TRAVELLERS WITH GOOD STORIES.

talk.text: You tell the tale of your journey so far. The whole shop cheers and loads you up with honey cakes.
You tell a story. It's... okay. They give you a cup of tea anyway.

look.text: Old carvings in the turtle's shell show dragons flying home to a mountain of fire. One carving is a rune stone, set into the shell: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: You gently pry the rune stone loose. The turtle doesn't seem to mind.
take.after: There's a rune-shaped hole in the shell now.

secrets.text: You call the turtle by her name. Far below, Old Shell hums a song so deep the city's teacups rattle. Everyone in your party feels braver.

stops.name: The Lantern Ferry Inn
stops.intro: A cosy inn on stilts over Silverlake. Lanterns sway, a cook sings in the kitchen, an old ferryman is mending nets, and an empty fishing boat bobs at the dock.

look.text: A hooded old man mending nets. His fingers are very quick.

talk.text: "Fish are biting by the dock. Take my boat if you like, just bring it back."
"I know you. You shared your bread with me on the road, when I was dressed as a beggar. Here, my lucky net."

look.text: A little boat with a rod and a bucket. The water below is full of silver fish.

use.text: You row out and cast a line...

look.text: A big dwarf in an apron, singing about potatoes.

talk.text: "Soup's free for anyone who can tell me what's sweeter than honey and older than stone!"

look.text: Through the window, far out on the lake, a small island glows. Something glints on it.

cast.text: You float across the water to the island. On it sits a rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

use.text: You cast the net out toward the island and pull back... a rune stone! RA on one side, TH on the other.
use.after: Nothing more to catch out there.

secrets.text: The cook roars with laughter. "Memories! Nobody ever gets it!" A huge bowl of soup each, and a bag of food for the road.
"Ha! Close enough, close enough." The cook ladles out soup for everyone.

stops.name: The Hall of Silverleaf
stops.intro: A great hall grown from living white trees. Elves in silver cloaks watch you quietly. There's a silver harp, a pool that shows the sky, and Lady Elowen sitting on a throne of roots.

look.text: The elf lady is very old and very calm. Her eyes go straight to the egg.

talk.text: "You found our lost little one in the wood. The elves of Silverleaf will not forget." She gives you a cloak that makes you hard to see.
"You have not been kind to my people. Leave by sunset."
"The dragon's egg. We hoped we would see one again. Rest here a night."

look.text: A harp with strings like moonlight. Nobody is playing it.

use.text: You play. The whole hall falls silent, then the elves begin to sing along. Lady Elowen smiles for the first time in a hundred years.
You pluck a string. TWANNG. An elf winces.

look.text: The pool shows the sky... but not this sky. It shows Ember Peak, with a great red dragon circling.

use.text: You touch the water. You see the way ahead: a hidden path that saves a day.

look.text: Between the roots of the throne is a rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: Lady Elowen nods. "Take it. It was always meant for the egg-bearer."
An elf guard steps in your way. "Not yours to take."

secrets.text: You say her name the elf way, softly. Lady Elowen bows her head and teaches you an old elf song that keeps the cold away.

stops.name: Granny Moss's Hut
stops.intro: Deep in Whisperwood stands a hut on wobbly chicken-like legs. Smoke curls from the chimney. There's a bubbling cauldron, a black cat on the step, and a door with no handle.

look.text: No handle, no keyhole. Carved above it: "Knock with a kind word."

use.text: You push. The door pushes back.

look.text: A black cat with one white whisker. It looks very unimpressed.

talk.text: The cat stares at you. You feel judged.

cast.text: The cat sighs: "Granny likes it when people say please. Honestly, humans."

look.text: A tiny old woman with mossy hair and very sharp eyes.

talk.text: "Oh, it's YOU, the kind ones who shared their bread with an old beggar on the road. That was me, dearie! Here, take this." She gives you a pouch of glowing herbs and blesses the egg.
"Hmph. A dragon egg. Keep it warm, keep it secret, and don't go poking trolls." She hands you some herbs.

look.text: It bubbles green and smells like... strawberries? A rune stone sits at the bottom.

take.text: Granny fishes the rune stone out with a ladle. "This old thing? Take it." RA on one side, TH on the other.
You reach in. It's HOT. Ow!

secrets.text: The door creaks open by itself. "Well, someone has MANNERS," says a voice. Granny Moss waves you in.

stops.name: The Sleeping Giant
stops.intro: In the middle of the frozen valley a frost giant sleeps, half buried in snow, snoring so hard icicles fall. Next to him is a pile of treasure, a giant's boot, and a cave out of the wind.

look.text: He's the size of a hill. His beard is full of frozen birds' nests. He looks... peaceful.

talk.text: You whisper hello. He snores louder. Snow slides off his nose.
You sing a lullaby. The giant smiles in his sleep, rolls over, and a sack of old giant food tumbles out of his pocket.

use.text: You play softly. The giant smiles, rolls over, and a sack of giant food tumbles out of his pocket.

look.text: Gold coins, silver cups, and on top, a black iron crown that seems to whisper.

take.text: You grab a handful of coins... the giant doesn't wake. Phew!
Clink! The giant's eye opens. You run! He rolls over and goes back to sleep, but you dropped half your food running.

look.text: A crown of black iron. It whispers: "Wear me. Rule everything." That seems like a bad idea.

take.text: You take the black crown. It feels heavy, and warm, and greedy.

look.text: A cave out of the wind. On the wall, someone has scratched a rune: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: You chip the rune stone out of the wall.

use.text: You shelter in the cave and light a fire. The egg warms up nicely.

look.text: A boot as big as your cart. Something is moving inside.

use.text: You peek in. A family of frostfoxes! They bound out and follow you for a while, which cheers everyone up.

secrets.text: Everyone sings together, as softly as you can. The giant hums along in his sleep, and the snow around you melts into a warm spring.

stops.name: The Goblin Market
stops.intro: Down in a cavern lit by stolen lanterns, goblins sell everything: pickled spiders, singing spoons, possibly your own luggage. Boss Snagtooth sits on a throne of pots. A goblin juggler juggles. A fortune teller beckons.

look.text: A fat goblin wearing three hats at once.

talk.text: "YOU! You're the ones that tricked my cousin! Prices are doubled, and also you smell!"
"Pip sent you? Pip's alright. Here's a goblin coin, spend it anywhere."
"Buy something or get out! Ooh, what's in the cart? Is that an EGG? I'll give you 80 gold for it."

look.text: A goblin juggling six knives and a live chicken.

talk.text: "Bet you 5 gold I can juggle your lantern!"

use.text: He juggles your lantern perfectly, then hands it back... with a goblin coin inside. "For being a good sport!"

look.text: An old goblin with a crystal ball that's actually a fishbowl.

talk.text: "Your future: a big dragon, a little dragon, and a door that wants three stones. That's 3 gold."

look.text: A heap of junk. Under a pickled spider jar is a rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: "That? Rock. Take it, whatever."
"Hands off, egg-thieves!"

use.text: You buy the rune stone with a goblin coin. RA on one side, TH on the other.

secrets.text: You compliment Boss Snagtooth's three hats. He is so flattered he gives you a fourth hat and a bag of food.

stops.name: The Gate of Ironroot
stops.intro: Two stone dwarf kings, as tall as towers, guard a great door in the mountain. Inside is a forge that never goes out, a trading hall, and a very grumpy gatekeeper named Brokk.

look.text: A dwarf with a beard so long he tucks it in his belt. Twice.

talk.text: "You pulled my brother out of that pit! Come in, come in! The forge is yours."
"Travelling with one of our own? Come in, cousins."
"No entry without a riddle answer. What has roots nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up it goes, and yet never grows?"

look.text: A forge that has burned for a thousand years. It's wonderfully warm.

use.text: You hold the egg near the forge. It glows and hums happily.
You borrow the anvil and fix up the cart properly.
use.after: The cart is as good as it gets.

look.text: Two stone kings. One holds a hammer, one holds a rune stone in his open hand: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: Brokk shrugs. "King Durin always said it was for whoever carried the egg."
Brokk growls. "Touch the kings and you'll be a statue too."

cast.text: The rune stone floats out of the stone king's hand and into yours. Brokk didn't see. Probably.

secrets.text: "A mountain! Correct!" Brokk grins. "Welcome to Ironroot." The dwarves give you warm food and fix your cart.

stops.name: The Sprite Ring
stops.intro: A perfect ring of glowing mushrooms. Tiny sprites with dragonfly wings zip around it, giggling. In the middle is a stump with a little golden cup on it, and a sign: NO BIG FEET IN THE RING.

look.text: Tiny glowing people, no bigger than your thumb, all talking at once.

talk.text: "Big people! Big feet! Play our game and we'll give you a gift! Guess what we're thinking!"
"A fox-folk! We LOVE fox-folk!" They braid flowers into everyone's hair.

use.text: The sprites go WILD for the honey cake. They teach you a spell to make plants grow.
use.after: The sprites are napping in a sugar coma.

look.text: A tiny golden cup full of glowing dew.

take.text: The sprites shriek. "THIEF!" You quickly put it back.

use.text: You drink a drop of the dew. You feel wonderfully awake. So does everyone else.

look.text: Mushrooms glowing blue and purple. Under the biggest one, a rune stone peeks out: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: You carefully pick out the rune stone without stepping in the ring.

look.text: Moonleaf grows here, the best healing herb there is. It only glows for a moment at a time.

take.text: You try to pick the glowing ones...

secrets.text: "You guessed it! We WERE thinking of mushrooms! We're always thinking of mushrooms!" The sprites shower you with gifts.
"Ooh, close! We were thinking about your egg a LITTLE bit." They give you one honey cake.

stops.name: The Sunken Tower
stops.intro: An old wizard's tower leans out of the swamp, half sunk in green water. Wisps float around its windows. There's a door above the water line, a rowing boat full of holes, and a frog the size of a cow sitting on a log.

look.text: A bogbelly toad, big as a cow, chewing slowly. Its tongue keeps flicking at the wisps.

talk.text: "RIBBIT." It is very deep and very loud.

cast.text: "Feed me and I'll carry you to the door," croaks the frog.

use.text: The frog swallows the honey cake whole and lets you ride on its back up to the tower door.

look.text: A door high on the tower, above the green water.

use.text: You throw the rope up, hook it on the door handle and climb.
use.after: The rope still hangs from the door.

cast.text: You float up to the door.

look.text: Inside, a wizard's study, dripping. A spellbook on the desk, and a rune stone used as a paperweight: RA on one side, TH on the other.

take.text: You take the rune stone and the soggy spellbook. You learn a spell to fix things.

look.text: Floating balls of light. They hum. One of them is following YOU.

use.text: You catch a wisp in the jar. It glows happily. Now you'll never be lost in the dark.
use.after: Your wisp hums in its jar.

talk.text: The wisps hum a tune. It's strangely catchy.

secrets.text: You hum the wisps' tune back to them. They swirl around you in delight and lead you along a secret dry path through the fen.

stops.name: The Star Bridge
stops.intro: Between two floating islands stretches a bridge made of starlight. A griffin nests on a rock spire. A skywhale drifts past below, singing. A stone warden with glowing eyes guards the start of the bridge.

look.text: A stone giant covered in moss, with glowing blue eyes. It hasn't moved in centuries.

talk.text: "ONLY THOSE WHO KNOW THE NAME OF THE SKY MAY CROSS." Its voice is like rocks rolling.
"CROSS, EGG-BEARER."

cast.text: The warden's eyes dim kindly. "YOU MAY CROSS. BUT THE NAME OF THE SKY STILL MATTERS."

look.text: Half eagle, half lion. It watches you, ready to pounce.

talk.text: The griffin you fed on the road! It flies down and lets everyone pet it, then drops a feather in your hand.
talk.after: The griffin purrs. Griffins purr, apparently.

talk.text: The griffin screeches. You back away.

use.text: The griffin snaps up the honey cake and decides you're alright. It drops a feather.

look.text: A whale swimming through the clouds, as big as a castle. On its back grows a little garden, and in the garden, something glints.

cast.text: You float down to the skywhale's back. In its garden, a rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

use.text: You hold up the feather and glide down to the skywhale's garden. A rune stone: RA on one side, TH on the other.

look.text: A bridge of pure starlight, thin as a ribbon.

use.text: You cross the star bridge. Below, the clouds glitter. It's the most beautiful thing any of you have ever seen.
The warden's stone hand blocks the way. "THE NAME OF THE SKY."

secrets.text: "CORRECT. THE SKY IS CALLED BLUE." The warden steps aside, looking slightly embarrassed it was that easy.
The warden is silent for a long time. "...YES. THAT IS ALSO ITS NAME." It steps aside and bows.

stops.name: Ember Peak
stops.intro: At last: the top of Ember Peak. Warm wind blows from the crater. There's a great stone nest lined with glowing coals, a door of black rock carved with three rune-shaped hollows, and far above, a huge red shape circling.
stops.kidsIntro: At last: the top of Ember Peak! Warm wind blows from the crater. There's a great stone nest lined with glowing coals, a door of black rock with three rune-shaped holes, and far above, a huge red dragon circling.

look.text: A nest of warm stone, glowing coals and old dragon scales. This is where the egg belongs. When you're ready, choose Finish the journey.

use.text: Not yet... look around first, then choose Finish the journey when you're ready.

look.text: Your rune stones hum. They want to go into the hollows. You remember the letters: KAEL... RA... TH...
Three rune-shaped hollows. Something is hidden behind this door, but it needs three rune stones, and a word.

use.text: You set the three rune stones in the hollows. They glow red. The door waits for a word.
You don't have three rune stones.

look.text: Cinderwing, the great red dragon, lands beside the nest. She remembers you. Her eyes are warm.
Cinderwing lands with a crash. Smoke curls from her nose. She remembers what you did.
The great red dragon lands at the edge of the peak and watches you. You can't tell what she's thinking.

talk.text: Cinderwing lowers her head and lets you touch her nose. It's warm, like a fireplace.
talk.after: Cinderwing hums deep in her chest.

talk.text: You say hello. Cinderwing blinks slowly. Is that good?

cast.text: Cinderwing speaks: "You carried my child across the world. I will not forget it."
Cinderwing's smoke fades. She seems calmer.

secrets.text: KAELRATH! The door grinds open. Inside is the Hidden Hoard of the dragons: gold, gems, and a crown of real fire that doesn't burn. Cinderwing nods. "It was always meant for whoever brought an egg home."
The door hums at the word... but stays shut. It needs all three rune stones.

endings.title: The Hidden Hoard
endings.text: You found the Hidden Hoard of the dragons. Cinderwing settles her egg into the nest and lets you take as much treasure as your cart can carry. Back in Hearthvale, they build a statue of you. It's a bit wonky, but you love it.

endings.title: Crown of Ash
endings.text: At the top of the peak the black crown whispers louder: "Wear me." You do. The egg is delivered, but you go home a ruler with cold eyes, and your friends slowly stop visiting. Maybe next time, leave the crown.

endings.title: Rich and Restless
endings.text: You sold the egg. You're richer than you ever dreamed, and every night you dream of a little dragon in a cage. Some journeys are better finished.
endings.kidsText: You traded the egg away for a big bag of gold. It's a lot of gold... but everyone feels a bit sad. Maybe next time, keep going!

endings.title: The Road Home
endings.text: Hungry, tired and out of hope, you turn the cart around. Someone else will have to carry the egg to Ember Peak. Hearthvale welcomes you home kindly, but you'll always wonder.

endings.title: The Empty Nest
endings.text: You reach Ember Peak, but the egg is gone, taken by the Baron's hunters. Cinderwing looks at the empty nest, then at you, and flies off toward the Baron's castle. You hear it was a very bad day for the Baron.
endings.kidsText: You reach Ember Peak, but the egg was taken by the Baron's collectors. Cinderwing flies straight off to get it back from his castle. The Baron is in BIG trouble.

endings.title: A Dragon of Your Own
endings.text: Little Ember hatched on the road and has followed you every step. At the peak, Cinderwing nuzzles her baby... then nudges her back toward you. "She chose you," the great dragon says. You go home with a dragon of your own.

endings.title: The Cold Stone
endings.text: The egg went cold on the road. You lay it in the nest anyway. Cinderwing breathes on it for a long, long time... and just as you turn to leave, you hear a tiny crack. Maybe. You'll never know for sure.

endings.title: Legend of Ember Road
endings.text: Everyone made it, even {pet}. Cinderwing roars so loud the whole kingdom hears, and the egg hatches right there in the nest. She carries you all home on her back, and songs about your journey are sung for a hundred years.

endings.title: Wings Over Hearthvale
endings.text: Cinderwing settles over the egg, then looks at you with something like a smile. She flies you home, swooping low over Hearthvale while everyone cheers. You'll be telling this story forever.

endings.title: The Lone Walker
endings.text: You climb the last steps alone. Everyone else stayed behind along the road. You lay the egg in the nest, and it's just you, the wind and a dragon. It's enough. On the way home, you visit every one of your friends.

endings.title: Fire on the Peak
endings.text: Cinderwing takes the egg... and remembers everything you did on the road. She roars fire into the sky and you run for it, all the way down the Ashen Steps. The egg is home, at least. Your eyebrows are not.
endings.kidsText: Cinderwing takes the egg... and remembers you weren't very nice on the road. She huffs a big puff of smoke and you all run down the mountain, giggling and coughing. The egg is home, at least!

endings.title: Ember Peak at Last
endings.text: You lay the egg in the great nest. Cinderwing curls around it and closes her eyes. Nobody says thank you, exactly, but the warm wind follows you all the way home.

creatures.name: Cinderwing
creatures.note: The last great red dragon. Remembers everything. Especially rudeness.

creatures.name: Bridge Troll
creatures.note: Charges a toll. Loves riddles. Smells like old socks and wet moss.

creatures.name: Mirewisp
creatures.note: A floating light. Follow a blue one home, never a green one.

creatures.name: Grimfang Goblin
creatures.note: Will sell you your own boots. Respects good haggling.

creatures.name: Frost Giant
creatures.note: Sleeps for a hundred years at a time. Snores avalanches.

creatures.name: Griffin
creatures.note: Half eagle, half lion, all attitude. Purrs if you scratch behind the beak.

creatures.name: Glowcap Sprite
creatures.note: Thumb-sized and sugar-mad. Always thinking about mushrooms.

creatures.name: Frostfox
creatures.note: A fluffy white fox that lives in giant boots. Brings good luck.

creatures.name: Bogbelly Toad
creatures.note: Big as a cow. Eats wisps. Will give you a ride for a snack.

creatures.name: Shadow Wolf
creatures.note: Grey wolves that hunt in the dark woods. Hate firelight.

creatures.name: River Serpent
creatures.note: A long silver snake in deep rivers. Collects shiny things.

creatures.name: Rockjaw Crab
creatures.note: A crab that looks exactly like a rock. Until it doesn't.

creatures.name: Skywhale
creatures.note: Swims through clouds. Grows gardens on its back. Sings at sunset.

creatures.name: Stone Warden
creatures.note: An ancient guardian. Takes riddles very seriously.

creatures.name: Glimmer Moth
creatures.note: Moths with lantern wings. They eat light, so keep your lantern close.

creatures.name: Thornling
creatures.note: Little twig creatures that tangle your wheels for fun.

creatures.name: Lantern Ghost
creatures.note: A sad ghost looking for its lost lantern. Harmless, mostly.

creatures.name: Fire Salamander
creatures.note: Lives in lava. Loves warm eggs. Harmless if you don't step on it.

creatures.name: Mushroom Folk
creatures.note: Walking mushrooms who speak very slowly. Very wise. Very slow.

creatures.name: The Baron's Hunters
creatures.note: Grey riders who hunt rare creatures for Baron Vexley's collection.

items.name: lantern
items.desc: A trusty oil lantern.

items.name: rope
items.desc: Fifty feet of good rope.

items.name: hammer
items.desc: A smith's hammer.

items.name: bow
items.desc: A hunting bow and arrows.

items.name: lute
items.desc: A battered lute. Plays three songs well.

items.name: honey cake
items.desc: Sticky, sweet, and loved by every creature alive.

items.name: warm stone
items.desc: A red stone that never cools. The egg loves it.

items.name: silver bell
items.desc: A tiny bell from Pip the mouse. Ring it when lost.

items.name: royal pass
items.desc: Lets you through the King's toll gates.

items.name: fishing net
items.desc: The ferryman's lucky net.

items.name: elf cloak
items.desc: Hard to see when you wear it.

items.name: goblin coin
items.desc: Goblin money. Spends anywhere, somehow.

items.name: black crown
items.desc: It whispers. Probably cursed.

items.name: griffin feather
items.desc: Hold it up and you can glide.

items.name: empty jar
items.desc: A glass jar with a cork.

items.name: wisp in a jar
items.desc: A friendly wisp. You'll never be lost in the dark.

items.name: troll tooth
items.desc: A lucky charm, apparently.

items.name: old map
items.desc: Shows shortcuts nobody else knows.

items.name: star shard
items.desc: A piece of a fallen star. Calms wild magic.

items.name: spider silk
items.desc: Stronger than rope and twice as sticky.

items.name: sack of food
items.desc: 30 food for the road.

items.name: healing herbs
items.desc: 2 bundles of healing herbs.

items.name: cart repair
items.desc: Fix the cart up like new.

spells.name: Light
spells.plain: A soft golden light glows over {on}. It's very pretty.

spells.name: Warmth
spells.desc: Warms something up. Good for eggs.
spells.plain: A warm glow spreads from your hands. The egg hums happily.

spells.name: Calm
spells.plain: A calm feeling washes over everyone.

spells.name: Float
spells.desc: Makes things float for a little while.
spells.plain: {on} floats up for a moment, then drops back down.

spells.name: Beast Speech
spells.plain: For a moment you understand every bird and beetle nearby. They mostly talk about food.

spells.name: Bloom
spells.plain: Berries burst out of every bush nearby!

backfires.text: {a} turns into a frog! It wears off by dinner, but {a} keeps eating flies.
All your food turns into butterflies and flutters away. They are very pretty butterflies.
Your gold turns into autumn leaves. Some of it turns back. Most of it doesn't.
The cart floats up into the air and crashes back down. CRUNCH.
Everyone's hair turns bright blue. {b} actually likes it.
A tiny rain cloud appears over {leader}'s head and follows them around all day.
It rains turnips. Hundreds of turnips. Well, that's dinner sorted.
The egg glows bright and hums loudly. That can't be good. Or maybe it's very good?
Everyone shrinks to the size of a mouse until sunset. You lose a day of travel.
{pet} can only speak in rhymes now. It's sublime. Every time.
A sudden snowstorm, just for you. Brrr.
The magic sparks and fizzes and goes wild. You feel it buzzing in your fingers.
The lantern sneezes. Then it sneezes again. Then it won't stop sneezing all day.
You summon a very confused chicken. It joins the party for a while and lays an egg. A normal egg.

campfire.text: {a} tells the story of the boy who befriended a dragon everyone else was afraid of.
{b} tells a funny tale about a wizard who couldn't stop turning things into cheese.
Around the fire, {a} tells the legend of a ring that should never have been made.
{leader} tells the tale of a girl who fell down a rabbit hole into a world of nonsense.
{b} tells a story about a castle of toys that came alive at night.
{a} tells a spooky story about a house in the woods. {b} pretends not to be scared.
{a} sings a song about pirates who sailed off the edge of the map.
{b} tells the story of a princess who rescued herself, and then the prince, and then the dragon.
{leader} tells a story of knights and quests and a very silly holy grail.
{a} tells of a magic school hidden from ordinary folk, where owls deliver the post.
{pet} curls up by the fire while {b} tells a story about a lost animal finding its way home.
{a} tells the tale of a hero who journeyed to the bottom of the sea.

markerLines: Should not have poked the troll
We had SO much food. Then we didn't.
We sang to a giant. Worth it.
Here we stopped. Here we laughed.

pets.name: Hoot
pets.desc: A wise little owl. Sees in the dark.

pets.name: Truffle
pets.desc: A dog with a mushroom cap. Sniffs out food.

pets.name: Pudding
pets.desc: A lazy orange cat. Brave when it matters.

pets.name: Sir Croaks
pets.desc: A toad in a tiny helmet. Very loyal.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.desc: Loves gold a little too much.

traits.name: Afraid of spiders
traits.desc: Screams at anything with eight legs.

traits.name: Secretly royal
traits.desc: Has a secret. A royal one.

traits.name: Strong
traits.desc: Can lift a cart. Has lifted a cart.

events.title: A Shadow in the Sky
events.text: A huge shadow sweeps over the road. High above, a great red dragon circles, sniffing the air. The egg in the cart grows warm and starts to hum.

choices.label: Hold the egg up for her to see
choices.text: You lift the egg high. The dragon dives... then pulls up, so close you feel the wind of her wings. She circles once and flies off toward Ember Peak.

choices.label: Hide under the cart
choices.text: Everyone squeezes under the cart. The dragon circles for an hour, then flies off. She didn't see the egg. Or did she?

choices.label: Shoot an arrow to scare her off
choices.text: The arrow bounces off her scales like a twig. She ROARS, and you're sure she will remember your face.

choices.label: Cast Beast Speech and call to her
choices.text: You call out: "We're taking your egg home!" The dragon hears. She bows her great head in the sky, and is gone.

events.title: The Dragon in the Net
events.text: You hear roaring from a valley. The great red dragon is caught in an enormous iron net, pinned by chains. Grey-cloaked hunters are setting up camp nearby. They haven't seen you.
events.kidsText: You hear roaring from a valley. The great red dragon is tangled in a big net! Grey-cloaked collectors are having lunch nearby. They haven't seen you.

choices.label: Sneak down and cut the chains

win.text: You saw through the last chain just as the hunters look up. The dragon bursts free, scatters their camp with one flap, and looks back at you for a long moment.

lose.text: A hunter spots you! You run for it, but someone gets hurt. Later you hear the dragon broke free on her own. She saw you try.

choices.label: Cast Float to lift the net
choices.text: The iron net rises like a sheet in the wind. The dragon shoots into the sky, free, and the hunters' camp is flattened by her tail on the way.

choices.label: Keep quiet and sneak past
choices.text: You leave her there. It feels awful. The roars follow you for miles.

choices.label: Sell the hunters directions to her nest
choices.text: The hunters pay you well. You don't sleep well.

events.title: Fire Over the Storm
events.text: A terrible storm rolls in. Lightning strikes the road ahead. Then a red shape drops out of the clouds and spreads her wings over your cart like an umbrella.

choices.label: Thank her
choices.text: Cinderwing shields you until the storm passes, then breathes a warm puff of air over the egg and flies away.

choices.label: Ask her to carry you a little way

win.text: She lowers a wing. You all climb on, cart and all, and fly a whole day's road in an hour. Nobody will ever believe you.

lose.text: She snorts smoke. Dragons are not ponies. But she stays until the storm ends.

events.title: Ashes on the Wind
events.text: A burnt smell on the wind. Far off, a dragon roars. Every bird in the forest goes quiet. Somebody, somewhere, made a dragon very angry.

choices.label: Keep your heads down
choices.text: You travel quietly and quickly.

choices.label: Leave a gift on a hilltop for her
choices.text: You leave your best food on a high rock as a peace offering. In the morning it's gone, and there's a scorch mark shaped like... a heart? Maybe?

events.title: The Grey Riders
events.text: Five riders in grey cloaks block the road. Their leader, a thin man with a silver whistle, smiles. "Baron Vexley collects rare things. Have you seen a dragon egg? There's a reward."

win.text: He looks at you for a long time, then shrugs and rides off.

lose.text: "Liar," he says softly. He blows his silver whistle and they ride away. You have a feeling you'll see him again.

choices.label: Pay them to go away (15 gold)
choices.text: The gold vanishes into his glove. "We never met," he says.

choices.label: Ask what the Baron would pay
choices.text: "Three hundred gold," he says. "Come to the Baron's camp on the road ahead, if you change your mind."

choices.label: Cast Calm on them
choices.text: The riders yawn. Their horses yawn. Even the leader yawns, and forgets what he was asking.

events.title: Thieves in the Night
events.text: In the middle of the night, a silver whistle blows. Shadows move around the cart. They're after the egg!

win.text: You drive them off with pots, pans, and one very brave {pet}. The egg is safe!

lose.text: In the chaos, a hunter grabs the egg and vanishes into the dark. It's gone!

choices.label: Hide the egg under the floorboards

win.text: They search everywhere but don't find it. They ride off cursing.

lose.text: They find the loose board. The egg is gone!

choices.label: Cast Light to blind them
choices.text: A blaze of light like noon! The hunters stumble around, blinded, and run off into the woods.

events.title: The Hunters' Camp
events.text: You follow the hoofprints to a camp in the trees. There it is: the egg, glowing faintly in a cage on a wagon. Two guards are playing cards beside it.

win.text: You slip in and out like shadows. The egg is back in your arms!

lose.text: A guard steps on {pet}'s tail. Alarm! You barely get away, without the egg.

choices.label: Challenge them to cards for it

win.text: Full house! The guards are furious but a bet is a bet. The egg is yours again.

lose.text: You lose. And lose your gold too.

choices.label: Cast Calm on the guards
choices.text: The guards fall asleep mid-hand. You walk in and take the egg back. Easy.

choices.label: Give up and move on
choices.text: It's too dangerous. You leave. Everyone is very quiet.

events.title: The Baron's Offer
events.text: A fancy tent by the road. Baron Vexley himself, in velvet, sits with a chest of gold. "Three hundred gold for the egg. Think of it: no more danger, no more hunger. Just go home rich."

choices.label: Sell the egg
choices.text: You take the gold. The Baron's servants carry the egg away. It doesn't hum anymore.

choices.label: "Not for all the gold in the world"
choices.text: The Baron's smile freezes. "We'll see." You leave quickly.

choices.label: Pretend to think about it, eat his snacks, leave
choices.text: You haggle for an hour, eat every cake on his table, and leave without selling. He's furious.

events.title: A Hungry Stranger
events.text: An old figure in a ragged cloak sits by the road, holding out a wooden bowl. "Spare a little bread for a poor traveller?"

choices.label: Share your food
choices.text: You fill the bowl. The stranger smiles a strange, sharp smile. "Kindness travels faster than you think."

choices.label: Share a honey cake
choices.text: The stranger's eyes light up. "A honey cake! Oh, you'll go far."

choices.label: Walk on by
choices.text: You pass by. The stranger watches you go.

events.title: Lost in the Leaves
events.text: A small elf child is sitting in a hollow tree, crying. "I followed a moth and now I can't find home."

choices.label: Help her find her way home
choices.text: You walk with her for a whole day, until silver-cloaked elves step out of the trees. They bow deeply.

choices.label: Give her the silver bell
choices.text: She rings the bell. Within moments, her mother appears from nowhere, scoops her up, and thanks you with tears in her eyes.

choices.label: Point her toward the nearest village
choices.text: She nods and trots off. You hope she'll be alright.

events.title: A Dwarf in a Hole
events.text: "OI! DOWN HERE!" A red-bearded dwarf has fallen into a deep pit by the road. "Fell in chasing a rabbit. Don't laugh."

choices.label: Throw down the rope
choices.text: You haul him out. "Brokk's my brother, at Ironroot gate. Tell him Durgan says you're good folk."

choices.label: Cast Float on him
choices.text: He floats out of the pit, swearing loudly the whole way, and lands on his bottom. "Thank you. I think."

choices.label: Invite him to join you
choices.text: "A dragon egg? Ha! I've always wanted an adventure." He climbs out on your shoulders and joins the party.

choices.label: Laugh and walk on
choices.text: He shouts some very colourful dwarf words after you.

events.title: The Fallen Griffin Chick
events.text: A fluffy griffin chick has fallen out of its nest onto the road. It squawks at you angrily. Its mother is nowhere to be seen.

choices.label: Feed it and climb up to the nest

win.text: You climb up the cliff and put it back. The chick squawks thanks. Somewhere far off, a griffin screams, and it doesn't sound angry.

lose.text: You slip halfway up, but the chick hops back into the nest from your shoulder.

choices.label: Cast Float to lift it home
choices.text: The chick floats up to its nest, squawking all the way.

choices.label: Leave it, its mother will come
choices.text: You move on. Hopefully its mother comes soon.

events.title: An Old Friend
events.text: The ragged stranger you fed on the road is sitting on a milestone, eating an apple. "Well, well. Kindness travels, I told you." She throws back her hood: an old woman with mossy hair and very sharp eyes. A witch!

choices.label: Ask for her help
choices.text: "For you, dearies? Of course." She taps the egg and everyone's sore feet with her stick.

choices.label: Share lunch with her again
choices.text: She cackles happily and eats half your bread. Then she gives you a jar of soup that never runs out (well, for a few days).

events.title: The Shell Game
events.text: A goblin with a folding table blocks the road. Three cups, one pebble. "Find the pebble, win 10 gold! Lose, I keep 5!"

win.text: You point at the middle cup. The goblin's jaw drops. You win!

lose.text: Wrong cup. (The pebble was up his sleeve all along.)

choices.label: Trick him back
choices.text: You distract him with a story and swap his cups. He loses all his gold to you and runs off, furious. You've made an enemy.

choices.label: Walk around him
choices.text: "Boring!" he shouts.

events.title: The Flooded Ford
events.text: Spring rains have flooded the ford. Brown water rushes over the stepping stones. The cart will have trouble here.

win.text: The wheels slip and splash but you make it across!

lose.text: A wheel catches on a rock. The cart tips and food goes floating away.

choices.label: Wait a day for the water to drop
choices.text: You camp on the bank. By morning the water is low enough to cross easily.

choices.label: Pay a farmer to pull you across (5 gold)
choices.text: A farmer and her huge ox tow you across without a splash.

choices.label: Cast Float on the cart
choices.text: The cart floats gently over the water like a big wooden duck.

events.title: The King's Toll Gate
events.text: A tall gate across the road. A bored guard: "Toll's 12 gold. King's orders. No exceptions. Unless you've got a royal pass."

choices.label: Show the royal pass
choices.text: The guard snaps to attention and opens the gate. "Right this way!"

choices.label: Pay the toll (12 gold)
choices.text: You pay. The gate creaks open.

choices.label: Sing for him instead
choices.text: The guard taps his foot, then joins in the chorus. He lets you through for free.

choices.label: Take the muddy back roads
choices.text: It takes two extra days through farm tracks and pig fields.

events.title: The Turtle Dives
events.text: The ground tilts! Old Shell, the giant turtle, is diving to scratch her belly on the sea floor. The whole city tips forward and the cart starts to roll!

choices.label: Grab the cart and hold on

win.text: You hold the cart steady until the turtle levels out. Phew.

lose.text: The cart rolls into a fruit stall. Squish. You pay for the damage.

choices.label: Tie the cart down with rope
choices.text: You lash it to a lamppost just in time. Everything else in the street goes sliding past.

choices.label: Ride it out in a tea shop
choices.text: You duck into a tea shop and wait it out with a cup of tea. The cart gets a few dents.

events.title: Crossing Silverlake
events.text: The road ends at the edge of a wide silver lake. There's a ferry with a sleepy ferrymaid, an old raft, and a long muddy road around the edge.

choices.label: Take the ferry (8 gold)
choices.text: The ferrymaid poles you across, humming. A smooth crossing.

win.text: Your raft is ugly but it floats! You paddle across.

lose.text: Halfway across the raft starts to come apart. You make it, soaking wet.

choices.label: Go the long way around
choices.text: Three days of muddy shore paths. At least it's pretty.

choices.label: Cast Float on the cart
choices.text: You float the cart across the lake. Fishermen drop their rods and stare.

events.title: The Thorn Wall
events.text: A wall of silver thorns blocks the forest road, too tall to climb. It's an elf ward. It shifts when you get close.

choices.label: Ask the elves to let you pass
choices.text: A voice in the trees: "You are known to us." The thorns part like a curtain.

choices.label: Cast Bloom to grow a path
choices.text: The thorns burst into flowers and bend aside, as if they're bowing.

choices.label: Hack through with tools
choices.text: You chop for hours. The elves are NOT happy about it.

choices.label: Find a way around
choices.text: Two days of searching for a gap.

events.title: The Troll Bridge
events.text: A stone bridge over a dark river. Under it, something big shifts and sniffs. A troll heaves itself up: "TOLL! Pay toll or answer riddle or get SQUASHED."
events.kidsText: A stone bridge over a river. Under it, something big shifts and sniffs. A troll heaves itself up: "TOLL! Pay toll or answer riddle! Or no bridge for you!"

choices.label: Pay the toll (10 gold)
choices.text: The troll bites each coin and lets you pass.

win.text: "What has a neck but no head?" "A bottle!" The troll grumbles and gives you a tooth as a prize.

lose.text: Wrong answer! The troll shakes the bridge. You make it across, but lose some things into the river.

choices.label: Give him a honey cake
choices.text: The troll's eyes go wide. He eats it in one bite and cries a little. "Nobody ever gives troll cake." He lets you pass and waves goodbye.

choices.label: Poke the troll and run
choices.text: Why would you do that? He's VERY angry. You get across, but he throws a rock at the cart.

events.title: The Frozen Pass
events.text: The pass is narrow and deep in snow. Above you, a huge shelf of snow hangs from the cliff. One loud noise and it'll all come down.

win.text: Not a sound. You're through! Then {a} sneezes, just after the last wheel clears the pass.

lose.text: {a} trips over a rock. CRASH. The snow comes down! You dig yourselves out.

choices.label: Wait for the sun to melt it
choices.text: Two cold days later the snow slides down by itself, harmlessly.

choices.label: Cast Warmth to melt a path
choices.text: Warm air pours from your hands and melts a tunnel right through. The egg loves it.

events.title: Goblin Roadblock
events.text: A wall of junk across the road: carts, barrels, a bathtub. Twenty goblins pop up behind it. "ROADBLOCK! Pay or play or go away!"

choices.label: Pay them (10 gold)
choices.text: They cheer, drag the bathtub aside, and wave you through.

choices.label: Play: who can make the funniest face

win.text: {a} pulls a face so ugly the goblins fall over laughing. You win!

lose.text: The goblin chief pulls a face so ugly it's actually frightening. You pay up.

choices.label: Show them a goblin coin
choices.text: "Ooh, a friend of the Market!" They let you through and give you snacks. The snacks are pickled spiders.

win.text: You smash through the bathtub! Goblins scatter, shouting rude words.

lose.text: The cart gets stuck in the bathtub. The goblins help themselves to your food.

events.title: The Broken Rope Bridge
events.text: A rope bridge over a deep chasm. Half the planks are missing and one rope is frayed nearly through.

choices.label: Fix it with your rope
choices.text: You tie it up good as new. Well, nearly. You cross carefully.

choices.label: Cast Mend on the bridge
choices.text: Planks fly back into place and the ropes twist themselves tight.

choices.label: Glide across with the griffin feather
choices.text: You glide across one by one, then pull the cart over on the ropes.

win.text: Step... by step... by step. You made it!

lose.text: A plank snaps! You make it across, but some supplies fall into the chasm.

choices.label: Find another way
choices.text: A long climb down and up again. Three days.

events.title: The Spore Storm
events.text: The giant mushrooms puff out a glittering cloud of spores. Anyone who breathes it in starts giggling and can't stop. The cloud drifts toward you.

choices.label: Cover your faces and push through

win.text: You make it through with only a few hiccups of laughter.

lose.text: Everyone giggles for a whole day. You get nowhere. It's actually quite nice.

choices.label: Run around the cloud
choices.text: You run. And run. You lose a bit of road, but nobody's giggling.

choices.label: Cast Calm on the mushrooms
choices.text: The mushrooms stop puffing. You didn't know mushrooms could relax, but here we are.

events.title: Follow the Lights
events.text: The road disappears into the bog. Three lights float ahead: a green one, a blue one, and a golden one. One of them knows the way.

choices.label: Follow the green light
choices.text: The green light leads you into deep mud! You lose a day getting the cart out.

choices.label: Follow the blue light
choices.text: The blue light leads you safely through the bog. Never trust a green wisp.

win.text: The golden light leads you to a dry island with a sunken chest of coins!

lose.text: The golden light leads you in a big circle. You're back where you started.

choices.label: Use your wisp in a jar
choices.text: Your wisp buzzes and points the way straight through.

choices.label: Ring the silver bell
choices.text: You ring the bell. The true path glows under your feet.

events.title: The Gap Between Isles
events.text: The next floating island has drifted away from this one. The gap is getting wider. The wind is strong and the drop is very, very long.

win.text: The cart flies through the air and lands with a crash on the far side. You did it!

lose.text: You make it, just, but the back wheel hangs over the edge and food tumbles into the clouds.

choices.label: Wait for the island to drift back
choices.text: It drifts back by evening. And then away. And then back again. You cross on the third try.

choices.label: Call the griffin
choices.text: You whistle. The griffin you helped swoops in and carries everyone across, one at a time, and then the cart.

choices.label: Cast Float on everything
choices.text: You float across the gap. It is the best moment of everyone's life.

events.title: The River of Fire
events.text: A river of glowing lava cuts across the Ashen Steps. Fire salamanders swim in it like fish. There's an old stone bridge, cracked and smoking.

win.text: The bridge holds! You're across.

lose.text: A chunk falls away behind the cart. You make it, but the cart is scorched.

choices.label: Ask the salamanders for help
choices.text: The salamanders recognise the egg. They swim together and make a bridge of their own warm backs. Hot, but safe!

choices.label: Cast Mend on the bridge
choices.text: The cracks seal shut. Safe and sound.

choices.label: Wait for the lava to cool
choices.text: It takes two days, but the lava crusts over into black rock you can walk on.

events.title: A Fallen Tree
events.text: A huge fallen tree blocks the road completely.

choices.label: Chop through it
choices.text: It takes all day, but you clear a path.

win.text: Heave! The tree rolls aside.

lose.text: Heave! Nothing. Someone pulls a muscle. You chop it in the end.

choices.label: Cast Float on the tree
choices.text: The tree floats up and settles back down off the road.

events.title: A Wandering Peddler
events.text: A peddler with a donkey and a hundred pots and pans rattles up the road. "Bargains! Everything must go! Except the donkey."

choices.label: Buy food (8 gold)
choices.text: You buy a big sack of bread and cheese.

choices.label: Buy honey cakes (4 gold)
choices.text: Sticky and wonderful.

choices.label: Buy an empty jar (2 gold)
choices.text: "Good for catching things," he winks.

choices.label: No thanks
choices.text: He rattles off, singing about pans.

events.title: Berry Bushes
events.text: The bushes by the road are heavy with fat purple berries. Some look delicious. Some look... suspicious.

win.text: Delicious! You fill every bag.

lose.text: Some of them were the suspicious kind. {a} has a very unhappy tummy.

choices.label: Cast Bloom on the bushes
choices.text: The bushes explode with berries. Enough for days!

choices.label: Leave them
choices.text: Better safe than sorry.

events.title: Leaky Roof
events.text: Rain pours through a tear in the cart's cover. Everything is getting wet, including the egg.

choices.label: Patch it in the rain
choices.text: You patch it, soaked to the bone.

choices.label: Huddle around the egg
choices.text: You keep the egg dry with your own cloaks. Everyone else gets wet.

choices.label: Cast Warmth to dry everything
choices.text: Steam rises from everyone. Toasty!

events.title: A Broken Wheel
events.text: CRACK. One of the cart wheels has split down the middle.

choices.label: Fix it with the hammer
choices.text: A few good bangs and it's sturdy again.

choices.label: Cast Mend
choices.text: The wood knits itself together with a creak.

choices.label: Bodge it with rope
choices.text: It wobbles, but it rolls.

choices.label: Limp on
choices.text: The cart wobbles badly.

events.title: Fever
events.text: {a} wakes up shivering and pale. A fever.

choices.label: Use herbs
choices.text: The herbs work quickly. {a} is up by lunch.

choices.label: Rest for a day
choices.text: A day of rest and soup. {a} feels much better.

choices.label: Keep going
choices.text: {a} rides in the cart, looking miserable.

events.title: The Travelling Minstrel
events.text: A minstrel with a feathered hat falls into step beside the cart. "A song for a coin, travellers?"

choices.label: Pay for a song (2 gold)
choices.text: He sings a ballad about a dragon who loved cheese. Everyone feels better.

choices.label: Sing a duet with him
choices.text: You harmonise beautifully. He's so impressed he gives YOU a coin.

choices.label: No thanks
choices.text: He sings anyway, getting quieter as he walks off.

events.title: Eyes in the Dark
events.text: Yellow eyes glint in the dark around your camp. Shadow wolves. They're hungry, and they're circling.

choices.label: Wait... that pup looks familiar
choices.text: It's the pup you freed from the brambles! The whole pack sits down, then trots away. They guard your camp all night.

choices.label: Build up the fire
choices.text: The fire roars. The wolves hate firelight and back away. You stay up all night feeding it.

choices.label: Throw them some food
choices.text: They snatch it up and slink away.

choices.label: Cast Light
choices.text: A flash like daylight! The wolves yelp and run.

win.text: You stand tall and shout. The wolves decide you're not worth it.

lose.text: A wolf darts in and nips {a} before running off with a bag of food.

events.title: A Lost Purse
events.text: A fat purse of coins lies in the middle of the road. There's a name sewn inside: "Mayor Pumble of Little Dimble."

choices.label: Keep it
choices.text: Finders keepers.

choices.label: Return it to Little Dimble
choices.text: It's a day out of your way. Mayor Pumble is SO grateful he gives you a reward and a big lunch.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Someone will come back for it.

events.title: A Scorching Day
events.text: The sun is brutal. Everyone is sweating, cranky, and out of water.

choices.label: Rest in the shade till evening
choices.text: You travel at night instead. Cooler, but slow.

choices.label: Push on
choices.text: {a} gets sunburnt and grumpy.

choices.label: Cast a snow spell... wait, you don't have one
choices.text: You try to cast Warmth backwards. It sort of works? A cool breeze.

events.title: A Falling Star
events.text: A star streaks across the night sky... and lands with a THUMP in a field nearby. It's still glowing.

choices.label: Go and look
choices.text: In a smoking crater lies a shard of starlight, humming softly. It makes magic feel calm and quiet.

choices.label: Make a wish
choices.text: You all make a wish. Nobody says what. Everyone feels hopeful.

events.title: Wild Magic
events.text: The air crackles around you. Sparks fly off {a}'s fingers. The wild magic you've been using is building up!

choices.label: Use the star shard to calm it
choices.text: The shard drinks up the wild magic and glows brighter.

choices.label: Meditate and let it fade
choices.text: You spend the day sitting quietly. It works, mostly.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: Your eyebrows start to smoke. Then {b}'s hat floats away.

events.title: The Talking Frog
events.text: A frog with a tiny crown hops onto the cart. "Kiss me and I'll turn into a prince and give you gold!"

win.text: POOF! A prince! He's very grateful and gives you a bag of gold.

lose.text: Nothing happens. The frog shrugs. "Worth a try." He hops off.

choices.label: Cast Beast Speech
choices.text: "Okay fine, I'm not a prince," the frog admits. "I just like kisses." He tells you about a shortcut though.

choices.label: Shoo him off
choices.text: He hops off in a huff.

events.title: Bandits!
events.text: Three bandits step out from behind a rock, waving rusty swords. "Your gold or your... um... everything else!"
events.kidsText: Three silly bandits jump out from behind a rock. "Your gold, please! Or else! ...Or else we'll be sad."

choices.label: Hand over some gold
choices.text: They take it and run off giggling.

win.text: You chase them off! One drops his own purse running.

lose.text: They knock {a} down and grab some gold.

win.text: Soon they're crying about their hard lives. You give them a sandwich and they become farmers.

lose.text: "Nice try." They take your gold.

choices.label: Cast Calm
choices.text: The bandits sit down and have a little cry. They wander off to rethink their lives.

events.title: The Egg Feels Cold
events.text: {a} puts a hand on the egg and gasps. "It's cold! It's getting cold!"

choices.label: Build a big fire
choices.text: You stop and build a huge fire. The egg warms slowly.

choices.label: Use the warm stone
choices.text: You tuck the warm stone in beside the egg. It glows happily.

choices.label: Cast Warmth
choices.text: Warm magic wraps around the egg. It hums.

choices.label: Wrap it in every blanket
choices.text: Everyone else is cold tonight, but the egg is snug.

events.title: The Egg Sings
events.text: In the night, the egg starts to hum. A soft, lovely tune. Everyone wakes up and listens.

choices.label: Hum along
choices.text: You all hum along. You sleep better than you have in weeks.

choices.label: Sing it a lullaby
choices.text: The egg glows gently while you sing. You feel it listening.

events.title: Something Moves
events.text: The egg wobbles! Something inside is kicking. It must be getting close to hatching.

choices.label: Hurry! Travel faster
choices.text: You set off at first light and push hard.

choices.label: Keep it calm and cool
choices.text: You keep it out of the sun and talk to it softly. It settles down.

choices.label: Cast Calm on the egg
choices.text: The wobbling stops. The egg sighs. Eggs can sigh, apparently.

events.title: Little Ember
events.text: Little Ember, your baby dragon, is hungry again. She's chewing on {b}'s boot.

choices.label: Feed her
choices.text: She eats an amazing amount for something so small.

win.text: She comes back with three rabbits and a very surprised fish.

lose.text: She sets a haystack on fire. You pay the farmer.

choices.label: Play with her
choices.text: She chases her own tail and sneezes sparks. Everyone laughs until they cry.

events.title: Where's {pet}?
events.text: {pet} has wandered off chasing something. They're nowhere to be seen.

choices.label: Search for {pet}
choices.text: After hours of calling, you find {pet} asleep in a hollow log, very pleased with themselves.

choices.label: Ring the silver bell
choices.text: Ding! {pet} comes running straight back.

win.text: {pet} catches up by evening, carrying a stick.

lose.text: {pet} doesn't come back. Everyone is miserable.

events.title: Look Who It Is!
events.text: Something comes bounding down the road toward you. It's your lost pet! They must have followed your trail for days.

choices.label: Hugs!
choices.text: Everyone piles on in a big happy heap.

events.title: First Snow
events.text: Thick snow fell overnight. {a} and {b} are already having a snowball fight.

choices.label: Join in!
choices.text: An epic snowball battle. Everyone's frozen and happy.

choices.label: Build a snow wall against the wind
choices.text: Cosy behind the wall, you warm the egg by the fire.

events.title: Lost in the Fog
events.text: The fog is so thick you can't see the road. You've been going in a circle for an hour.

choices.label: Wait for it to lift
choices.text: By afternoon you can see again.

choices.label: Follow {pet}'s nose
choices.text: {pet} leads you right back onto the road.

choices.label: Cast Light
choices.text: Your light cuts through the fog like a lighthouse.

choices.label: Use the old map
choices.text: The map shows a landmark. You're back on track, with a shortcut too.

events.title: An Argument
events.text: {a} and {b} are arguing about whose turn it is to cook. It's getting loud.

choices.label: Make {a} cook
choices.text: {a} cooks, grumbling. {b} is smug about it.

choices.label: Cook yourself
choices.text: You cook. It's terrible. Everyone laughs, and the argument is forgotten.

choices.label: Tell a story to calm things down
choices.text: By the end of your story, they're friends again.

choices.label: Cast Calm
choices.text: They both sit down and say sorry at the same time.

events.title: Camp Cooking
events.text: The party's good cook has an idea: a stew made from roots, mushrooms and the last of the cheese.

choices.label: Let them cook
choices.text: It's the best thing anyone has ever eaten. And it stretches for days.

events.title: The Spider
events.text: A spider the size of a teacup drops onto the cart. Someone who is VERY afraid of spiders screams so loud birds fly out of every tree.

choices.label: Gently move the spider
choices.text: You put it on a bush. It's actually quite cute. It leaves behind some silk.

choices.label: Run!
choices.text: Everyone runs. You come back for the cart an hour later.

events.title: A Royal Secret
events.text: By the fire, one of your party sighs. "I should tell you. My grandmother was a princess. I'm... sort of royal."

choices.label: Bow dramatically
choices.text: Everyone bows. They throw a pinecone at you. It's lovely.

choices.label: Use it to get free stuff
choices.text: The next town gives you free food when they hear. Royalty has its perks.

events.title: Gold Fever
events.text: In the morning, some gold is missing. And one of the party is looking very shifty.

choices.label: Ask them about it
choices.text: They hand it back, embarrassed. "I just like to count it."

choices.label: Let it go
choices.text: It's only gold.

events.title: Whoops
events.text: Somebody clumsy trips over a rock, falls into the cart, and knocks over the food barrel.

choices.label: Help clean up
choices.text: You save most of it.

choices.label: Laugh
choices.text: Everyone laughs. Even the clumsy one.

events.title: Lucky Find
events.text: Your lucky friend kicks a stone and it turns out to be a gold nugget. Of course it does.

choices.label: Of course
choices.text: Lucky.

events.title: Night Watch
events.text: Your night owl friend stayed up and spotted thieves sneaking toward the cart. They woke everyone in time.

choices.label: Good owl
choices.text: The thieves ran off empty-handed.

events.title: Green Things
events.text: Dinner is cabbage soup. The picky eater refuses to eat it.

choices.label: Make them something else
choices.text: More food used, one happy friend.

choices.label: Tell them to eat it
choices.text: They eat it, slowly, glaring at you the entire time.

events.title: Complaints
events.text: "My feet hurt. It's too sunny. Who packed these boots? Why is the egg looking at me?" Someone is very grumpy today.

choices.label: Let them ride in the cart
choices.text: Grumbling stops. Cart slows.

choices.label: Ignore them
choices.text: They complain all day. It's quite impressive.

events.title: Stuck in the Mud
events.text: The cart is stuck in deep mud, right up to the axles.

win.text: With a great SCHLOOP the cart pops free.

lose.text: It takes the rest of the day to dig it out.

choices.label: Cast Float
choices.text: The cart pops out of the mud like a cork.

events.title: The Hermit's Riddle
events.text: An old hermit sits at the mouth of a cave. "Answer my question and I'll show you a shortcut. What gets wetter the more it dries?"

choices.label: "A towel"
choices.text: "Correct!" He shows you a hidden path through the hills.

choices.label: "A fish"
choices.text: "No. Fish are always wet." He goes back to sleep.

choices.label: "The sea"
choices.text: "Hmm. Interesting, but no." He gives you a carrot for trying.

events.title: A Wizard's Challenge
events.text: A young wizard in purple robes blocks the road. "I challenge you to a MAGIC DUEL! Winner gets the loser's lunch!"

win.text: Your spells are better. She hands over her lunch and a spell scroll.

lose.text: She turns your hat into a pigeon. You hand over lunch.

choices.label: Offer to share lunch instead
choices.text: She was really just hungry. She teaches you a trick to calm wild magic as thanks.

events.title: A Sick Village
events.text: A tiny village where everyone is coughing. A worried mother asks: "Do you have any medicine?"

choices.label: Give them your herbs
choices.text: The village recovers. They pack your cart with food and blessings.

choices.label: Healer: tend to them
choices.text: You spend a day helping. The whole village cheers when you leave.

choices.label: Keep your distance
choices.text: You move on quickly. It doesn't feel good.

events.title: A Harvest Festival
events.text: You arrive at a village in the middle of a harvest festival. Lanterns, music, and a pie-eating contest!

win.text: {a} eats eleven pies and wins a prize ham!

lose.text: {a} eats nine pies and has to lie down for a day.

choices.label: Dance all night
choices.text: Everyone dances until dawn.

choices.label: Sell things at the fair
choices.text: Festival-goers pay good money for anything shiny.

events.title: The Lantern Ghost
events.text: A pale ghost floats beside the road, wringing its hands. "My lantern... I've lost my lantern... I can't rest without it."

choices.label: Give it your lantern
choices.text: The ghost smiles, lights the lantern, and fades away peacefully. Where it stood, there's a pile of old coins.

win.text: You find its lantern in a ditch! The ghost thanks you and vanishes.

lose.text: You search all night with no luck. The ghost sighs and drifts away.

choices.label: Run away
choices.text: You run. It doesn't follow. It just looks sad.

events.title: Glimmer Moths
events.text: A cloud of moths with glowing wings swarms your lantern. They're drinking its light! It's getting darker.

choices.label: Cover the lantern
choices.text: They flutter off disappointed. Dark night, though.

choices.label: Cast Light to feed them
choices.text: You make a big ball of light for them. They feast happily and leave you a gift of glowing dust.

choices.label: Catch one in a jar
choices.text: You catch a moth. It glows softly all night, then you let it go.

events.title: Thornlings
events.text: Little twig creatures are tangling the cart wheels with vines and giggling. They think it's hilarious.

choices.label: Chase them off
choices.text: They scatter, but the vines take an hour to untangle.

choices.label: Play their game
choices.text: You tangle THEM up in vines instead. They LOVE it. They show you a shortcut.

choices.label: Cast Bloom on the vines
choices.text: The vines burst into flowers. The thornlings are delighted and wave goodbye.

events.title: Rocks That Walk
events.text: You sit on a rock for lunch. The rock moves. It's a rockjaw crab, and you're sitting on its head.

choices.label: Apologise and back away slowly
choices.text: It snaps once, then scuttles off.

choices.label: Feed it a honey cake
choices.text: The crab loves it. It follows you for a while and clears the road of rocks.

choices.label: Grab your lunch and run
choices.text: It snips the corner off the food bag.

events.title: River Serpent
events.text: A long silver serpent rises from the river and hisses. It's staring at something shiny in your cart.

choices.label: Toss it something shiny
choices.text: You throw it a few coins. It catches them, pleased, and sinks away.

choices.label: Back away from the water
choices.text: You go the long way, away from the river.

choices.label: Cast Beast Speech
choices.text: "Shiny?" it asks. You show it your lantern. It's so impressed it gives you a pearl.

events.title: The Slow Travellers
events.text: Two walking mushrooms are crossing the road. Very... very... slowly. "Hellooooo," says one. It takes a whole minute.

choices.label: Wait for them to cross
choices.text: It takes an hour. They thank you with some very rare mushrooms that are good for healing.

choices.label: Carry them across
choices.text: "Weeeeeee," they say. They give you a blessing of good sleep.

events.title: A Merchant Caravan
events.text: A long caravan of merchant wagons passes, heading the other way. They're happy to trade.

choices.label: Buy food (10 gold)
choices.text: Good fresh food.

choices.label: Buy herbs (6 gold)
choices.text: A bundle of healing herbs.

choices.label: Sell your spare things
choices.text: They give you a fair price for a few odds and ends.

choices.label: Merchant: trade cleverly
choices.text: You make five clever trades in a row and come out well ahead.

choices.label: Wave and move on
choices.text: They wave back.

events.title: Deer Tracks
events.text: Fresh tracks lead into the woods. There could be food out there.

win.text: A good hunt. Plenty of food.

lose.text: Nothing but sore feet.

choices.label: Forage for roots and nuts
choices.text: A few handfuls of food.

choices.label: Fish in a nearby stream
choices.text: You find a good spot...

events.title: Rockslide!
events.text: Rocks start tumbling down the slope ahead! You'll have to steer the cart through.

choices.label: Take the reins!
choices.text: Hold on tight...

choices.label: Wait for it to stop
choices.text: You wait an hour, then pick your way through the rubble.

events.title: Moonleaf Meadow
events.text: A meadow where moonleaf grows, the best healing herb in the kingdom. It only glows for a moment, and that's when you can pick it.

choices.label: Pick moonleaf
choices.text: Get ready...

choices.label: Healer: pick it the old way
choices.text: You know exactly how. You fill a whole bag.

choices.label: Move on
choices.text: Maybe next time.

events.title: A Traveller Wants to Join
events.text: An elf in a travel-stained cloak walks beside the cart for a while. "I'm heading east too. Could I join you? I'm good with a bow and terrible at cooking."

choices.label: Welcome aboard!
choices.text: One more friend for the road.

choices.label: Sorry, not enough food
choices.text: The elf nods and walks on.

events.title: The Fox-folk Juggler
events.text: A fox-folk with a bushy tail is juggling apples at a crossroads. "Need a juggler? Lookout? Sneak? Thief? I mean... not a thief."

choices.label: Join us!
choices.text: The fox-folk grins and hops onto the cart.

choices.label: No thank you
choices.text: "Your loss!" They juggle off.

events.title: The Dwarf Who Missed the Boat
events.text: A dwarf sits on a huge pack, looking fed up. "Missed my caravan. Can I ride with you? I can fix anything with wheels."

choices.label: Hop on
choices.text: She fixes the cart before you've gone a mile.

choices.label: Sorry, we're full
choices.text: "Bah," says the dwarf.

events.title: An Old Friend on the Road
events.text: Someone is running down the road behind you, waving. It's a friend who had to stay behind! They've rested, healed, and caught up.

choices.label: Welcome them back!
choices.text: Hugs all round.

events.title: Thunderstorm
events.text: Lightning strikes a tree just ahead. The horse rears. The storm is getting worse.

choices.label: Shelter under a rock overhang
choices.text: You wait it out, damp and safe.

win.text: You make good time through the rain.

lose.text: A branch smashes onto the cart.

events.title: A Double Rainbow
events.text: After the rain, a double rainbow arches over the road. At the end of it, something sparkles.

choices.label: Run to the end of the rainbow
choices.text: You find a little pot of chocolate coins! And some real ones.

choices.label: Make a wish
choices.text: Everyone makes a wish on the rainbow.

events.title: Bunny Parade
events.text: Dozens of bunnies hop across the road in a long line, like a parade. One stops and sniffs the egg.

choices.label: Wait and watch
choices.text: It takes a while. It's the cutest thing ever.

choices.label: Share some carrots
choices.text: The bunnies are delighted. Their leader leaves you a four-leaf clover.

events.title: A Tempting Shortcut
events.text: A narrow overgrown path cuts off a big bend in the road. It might save a day. Or it might not.

win.text: It works! You save a lot of road.

lose.text: The path ends at a cliff. Back you go.

choices.label: Stick to the road
choices.text: Slow and steady.

events.title: The Wishing Well
events.text: An old stone well by the road. A sign: "Toss a coin, make a wish."

choices.label: Toss a coin and wish for food
choices.text: You hear a splash... and a voice from the bottom: "Fine. Here." A bucket comes up full of apples.

choices.label: Wish for luck
choices.text: You feel lucky. Whether you are, who knows.

choices.label: Look down the well
choices.text: Something down there looks back. You decide not to wish today.

events.title: The Talking Signpost
events.text: A signpost with a face. "Lost? I know every road. Ask me anything. But ask NICELY."

choices.label: "Please, which way is fastest?"
choices.text: "Since you asked so nicely: that way." It points along a path that saves you hours.

choices.label: "Just tell me, plank"
choices.text: "Well! RUDE." It points you the wrong way.

events.title: Kind Farmers
events.text: A family of farmers waves you down. "You look hungry! Stay for supper?"

choices.label: Yes please!
choices.text: A huge supper and a warm barn to sleep in.

choices.label: Help with the harvest in return
choices.text: A day of hard work, but they send you off with a cart full of food.

events.title: The Duck Bridge
events.text: A very official-looking duck stands on a little bridge. "QUACK." It wants a toll.

choices.label: Pay the duck a breadcrumb
choices.text: "Quack," it says, satisfied, and waddles aside.

choices.label: Quack back
choices.text: You have a long quacking conversation. The duck lets you through, and so do its six ducklings.

events.title: The Waving Scarecrow
events.text: A scarecrow in a field is waving at you. Scarecrows aren't supposed to do that.

choices.label: Wave back
choices.text: It waves harder, delighted. A crow on its shoulder drops a shiny coin at your feet.

choices.label: Take a closer look
choices.text: It's a farm boy in a scarecrow costume, bored out of his mind. He gives you an apple for the company.

events.title: The Village Sends You Off
events.text: As you leave Hearthvale, the whole village lines the road. Old Granny Tibbs presses a parcel into your hands. "For the road, dears. Bring that egg home safe."

choices.label: Open it
choices.text: Honey cakes! Four of them... well, one now, after {a} ate three.

choices.label: Give a speech
choices.text: "We won't let you down!" Everyone cheers.

events.title: Runaway Pig
events.text: A huge pig thunders down the road, chased by a red-faced farmer. "STOP THAT PIG!"

win.text: You tackle it! The farmer is so grateful he gives you a big ham. Not that ham. A different one.

lose.text: The pig runs straight over {a}. Splat.

choices.label: Get out of the way
choices.text: The pig and the farmer thunder past.

events.title: The Old Soldier
events.text: An old soldier sits on a fence. "Taking an egg to Ember Peak? Ha! I tried that once, fifty years ago. Here's my advice: keep it warm, and never, ever take the green light."

choices.label: Thank him
choices.text: He salutes. You'll remember that.

choices.label: Ask what happened
choices.text: "Took the green light. Spent three weeks in a swamp. Lost my boots." He gives you his old map.

events.title: Knights at the Inn
events.text: A group of knights at a roadside inn are boasting loudly about the dragons they've slain. One spots your cart. "What's under the blanket there?"

win.text: "Turnips. Ha!" They go back to their boasting.

lose.text: They pull back the blanket. "A dragon egg?!" You flee in the confusion, leaving supplies behind.

choices.label: Buy them a round of drinks
choices.text: They love you. They forget all about the cart.

events.title: The Royal Parade
events.text: Trumpets! A royal parade comes down the road and everyone has to move aside. The young Queen waves from her carriage.

choices.label: Bow politely and wait
choices.text: The parade takes half a day to pass. Lovely, but slow.

choices.label: Wave the egg at the Queen
choices.text: The Queen sees the egg and gasps. She sends a knight over with a royal pass and a basket of snacks!

choices.label: Royal: wave like you know her
choices.text: She waves back! A servant brings you a royal pass. "Cousin! Safe travels!"

events.title: A Guard Checkpoint
events.text: Guards are searching every cart. "Looking for smugglers. Open up!"

win.text: They don't notice the egg under the turnips. "Move along."

lose.text: They find the egg. "Not smuggling, then." They let you go, but word spreads.

choices.label: Show the royal pass
choices.text: "Oh! Sorry to bother you!"

choices.label: Hide the egg in the elf cloak
choices.text: They search right past it.

events.title: The Jousting Tournament
events.text: There's a jousting tournament in a field. The prize for the archery contest is 30 gold.

win.text: Bullseye! You win 30 gold and a lot of cheering.

lose.text: You hit a scarecrow. Close!

choices.label: Watch and eat pies
choices.text: A fun day out. The pies are excellent.

choices.label: Sell lemonade to the crowd
choices.text: Business is good!

events.title: The Tax Collector
events.text: A tax collector with a very large ledger stops your cart. "Road tax! One gold per wheel. Plus the horse. Plus a hat tax. Are you wearing a hat?"

choices.label: Pay up (5 gold)
choices.text: He makes a little tick in his ledger.

choices.label: Argue the hat tax isn't real

win.text: He looks in his ledger. "Huh. It isn't." He leaves embarrassed.

lose.text: It IS real, it turns out. He adds a fine.
