events.title: The Floating Fish Market
events.text: Boats tie up along the turtle's shell to sell fish. Everything smells amazing.

choices.label: Buy fish (5 gold)
choices.text: Grilled fish for everyone, and some packed for the road.

choices.label: Fish off the edge of the shell
choices.text: You find a quiet spot...

events.title: Quick Fingers
events.text: In a busy street, someone bumps into {a}. Later, {a} notices their purse is gone.

win.text: You catch a scruffy kid with your purse. You let them keep a coin. They look surprised.

lose.text: They vanish into the crowd.

choices.label: Shrug it off
choices.text: Gone is gone.

events.title: The Lantern Keeper
events.text: A lighthouse sits on the turtle's head. The keeper, an old woman, says the lamp has gone out and ships will crash on the turtle tonight.

choices.label: Cast Light in the lamp
choices.text: A beam of light sweeps out across the sea. The keeper hugs you.

choices.label: Lend her your lantern oil
choices.text: It's enough for one night. She thanks you with a bag of food.

choices.label: Sorry, can't help
choices.text: She sighs and goes back up the stairs.

events.title: Seasick
events.text: The turtle is swimming through big waves today. The whole city rolls up and down. {a} is very green.

choices.label: Herbs for the tummy
choices.text: Much better.

choices.label: Look at the horizon
choices.text: It helps a little.

events.title: Jumping Off
events.text: The turtle swims close to the shore. A sailor shouts: "If you jump off here, you'll save a day!"

choices.label: Jump the cart off the shell!

win.text: SPLASH! You land in the shallows and roll onto the beach. A shortcut!

lose.text: SPLASH! The cart lands in deep water. You drag it out, soaked.

choices.label: Stay on the turtle
choices.text: Safe and slow.

events.title: The Reed Boat Folk
events.text: People in little reed boats paddle up alongside. "Travellers! Come trade with the river folk!"

choices.label: Trade honey cakes for fish
choices.text: They love it. You get a lot of fish.

choices.label: Ask about the road ahead
choices.text: They tell you about a dry path along the shore.

events.title: The Mist on the Water
events.text: A pale figure made of mist rises from the lake and sings, beckoning you toward the water.

choices.label: Cover your ears and keep going
choices.text: You stuff your ears with moss and march on.

choices.label: Sing back louder
choices.text: Your song is so loud and so bad, the mist maiden sinks back under the water in disgust.

win.text: She stops singing, surprised anyone came. She gives you a pearl and vanishes.

lose.text: You wade in and get soaked to the skin.

events.title: Otter Thieves
events.text: A family of otters is unpacking your food bags, very politely, one item at a time.

choices.label: Shoo them
choices.text: They run off with a fish each.

choices.label: Let them have a snack
choices.text: They're so cute it's worth it.

events.title: The Frozen Lake
events.text: The lake has frozen solid. You could cross it straight instead of going around... if the ice holds.

win.text: It holds! You slide across, saving days.

lose.text: CRACK. A wheel goes through. You get it out, but everyone's frozen.

choices.label: Go around
choices.text: Safe and slow.

events.title: The Drowned Bell
events.text: From under the water, a bell is ringing. The river folk say a whole village sank here long ago.

choices.label: Ring the silver bell back
choices.text: The two bells ring together. Bubbles rise, and a small chest floats to the surface.

choices.label: Listen quietly
choices.text: It's sad and beautiful.

events.title: The Elf Patrol
events.text: Arrows thunk into the tree beside you. Elf archers step out of nowhere. "Who brings fire-blood into Silverleaf?"

choices.label: Show them the egg
choices.text: The elves gasp and lower their bows. "A dragon egg... it's been so long." They escort you safely.

choices.label: Let your elf friend talk
choices.text: A few words in Elvish and they're laughing together like old friends.

choices.label: Run!
choices.text: Elves are fast. Very fast. They let you go, but they're not happy.

events.title: The Singing Trees
events.text: The white trees sing as the wind moves through them. It's so beautiful that everyone stops walking.

choices.label: Rest and listen
choices.text: You rest for a while. Everyone feels better.

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.text: The music follows you for miles.

events.title: The White Stag
events.text: A white stag with silver antlers stands in the road. It looks right at the egg, then at you.

choices.label: Bow to it
choices.text: It bows back, then leads you along a hidden path.

choices.label: Hunt it
choices.text: The arrow passes right through it like smoke. The stag vanishes. The whole forest goes cold and quiet.

events.title: An Elf Feast
events.text: The elves invite you to a moonlight feast. The food is light as air and tastes like summer.

choices.label: Join the feast
choices.text: You eat, sing and dance till dawn. They pack you elf bread for the road (it lasts forever).

events.title: The Path Moves
events.text: The forest path behind you has vanished. The trees have moved. You're not sure which way is forward.

win.text: You find the way again.

lose.text: You wander for a day before finding the road.

choices.label: Ring the silver bell
choices.text: The trees shuffle back to where they were, looking guilty.

choices.label: Ask the trees nicely
choices.text: "Please?" you ask. After a long pause, a path opens. Trees like manners.

events.title: The Whispering Trees
events.text: The trees are whispering your names. "{leader}... {a}... leave the egg... leave it..."

choices.label: Shout back
choices.text: "NO!" The whispers stop, startled.

choices.label: Hum loudly and walk on
choices.text: You hum all day. It works.

choices.label: Listen to them
choices.text: They tell you about a hidden stash of supplies... and also some very rude things about your hat.

events.title: The Great Web
events.text: A huge web stretches across the path. Something big is sitting in the middle, and it has a lot of legs.
events.kidsText: A huge sparkly web stretches across the path. A big fuzzy spider sits in the middle, waving at you with all eight legs.

win.text: Slash slash! You're through before it moves.

lose.text: The web sticks to everything. You lose half a day pulling it off.

choices.label: Go the long way around
choices.text: A long detour through the brambles.

choices.label: Cast Light
choices.text: The spider hates light! It scurries off and you walk through, collecting some silk.

events.title: A Fairy Ring
events.text: A ring of red mushrooms in a clearing. Old stories say: step inside and you'll dance till dawn.

choices.label: Step inside
choices.text: You dance all night. You don't remember most of it. Somehow you feel great.

choices.label: Walk around it
choices.text: Better not.

events.title: A Voice in the Woods
events.text: "Help! Help me!" A child's voice, off the path, in the dark trees.

win.text: It's a real child, a woodcutter's daughter! You take her home. Her father gives you food and a shortcut.

lose.text: It was a trick by a mischievous imp! It steals your bootlaces and cackles away.

choices.label: Stay on the path
choices.text: You stay on the path. The voice stops. You'll never know.

events.title: The Wise Owl
events.text: An enormous owl looks down from a branch. "Whooo carries the egg?"

choices.label: "We do"
choices.text: "Then hurry. The grey riders are close behind." It flies off.

choices.label: Let {pet} talk to it
choices.text: The two owls hoot at each other for a while. The big one gives Hoot a shiny thing. It's a coin!

events.title: A Wolf Pup
events.text: A tiny shadow wolf pup is tangled in a bramble, whimpering.

choices.label: Untangle it
choices.text: You free it. It licks your hand and runs off. That night, the wolves leave your camp alone.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: You walk on. Its whimpers follow you.

events.title: The Ice Cave
events.text: A blizzard hits! There's a cave in the ice cliff, glowing blue.

choices.label: Shelter in the cave
choices.text: It's beautiful in there. Frozen inside the ice walls are old coins, and you chip a few out.

choices.label: Push on through the blizzard
choices.text: Brutal. Everyone is half frozen.

choices.label: Cast Warmth and keep going
choices.text: A bubble of warm air keeps you all cosy.

events.title: Big Footprints
events.text: Footprints in the snow, each one as big as a cartwheel. They lead toward a cave with smoke coming out.

win.text: A young giant, cooking soup. She's lonely and shares her soup gladly.

lose.text: An old giant, grumpy from his nap. He throws a snowball the size of a house at you.

choices.label: Go the other way
choices.text: Very sensible.

events.title: The Frozen Knight
events.text: A knight frozen inside a block of ice, sword raised. He's been there a very long time. His eyes move.

choices.label: Cast Warmth to thaw him
choices.text: The ice melts. The knight gasps, shivers, and thanks you. "A hundred years! What year is it?" He gives you his purse.

choices.label: Chip him out
choices.text: It takes all day, but he's free. He's very grateful and gives you his lucky troll tooth.

choices.label: Leave him
choices.text: His eyes follow you sadly.

events.title: Frostfox Family
events.text: White foxes with fluffy tails are playing in the snow. One sneaks up and curls around the egg, keeping it warm.

choices.label: Let it stay
choices.text: It rides with you all day. The egg stays toasty.

choices.label: Give it a treat
choices.text: It brings its whole family. They keep you warm all night.

events.title: Rumbling
events.text: The mountain rumbles. Snow trickles down the cliffs above. Something big might be coming.

win.text: You get clear just as the snow comes down behind you.

lose.text: The edge of the avalanche catches the cart.

choices.label: Take cover and wait
choices.text: The avalanche thunders past. You dig out.

events.title: Goblin Tunnels
events.text: A goblin pops out of a hole in the ground. "Shortcut through the tunnels? Only 5 gold. Totally safe. Mostly."

win.text: Dark, smelly, and very fast. You pop out miles ahead!

lose.text: The "shortcut" leads in a circle. The goblin has vanished with your gold.

choices.label: No thanks
choices.text: "Your loss!"

events.title: A Goblin Wedding
events.text: You stumble into a goblin wedding! The bride is wearing a teapot as a hat. "GUESTS! Free cake for guests!"

choices.label: Join the party
choices.text: Goblin cake is mostly mud, but the dancing is amazing.

choices.label: Give a wedding present
choices.text: You give them your spider silk... or some other bit of junk. They're thrilled!

choices.label: Slip away
choices.text: Nobody notices.

events.title: Hill Wolves
events.text: Big wolves with goblin riders come howling down the hill!
events.kidsText: Goblins riding big fluffy wolves come racing down the hill, waving flags!

win.text: You race them to the bridge and lose them!

lose.text: They catch up and grab some supplies before riding off whooping.

choices.label: Throw food to the wolves
choices.text: The wolves stop to eat, and the goblins fall off. You escape.

choices.label: Cast Calm
choices.text: The wolves lie down and roll over for belly rubs. The goblins are baffled.

events.title: The Hot Springs
events.text: Steam rises from bubbling hot springs between the rocks.

choices.label: Have a soak
choices.text: Everyone soaks their sore feet. Bliss.

choices.label: Warm the egg in the steam
choices.text: The egg loves it.

events.title: The Goblin Tax
events.text: Goblins have heard about you. Lots of goblins. They're throwing things.

choices.label: Apologise loudly
choices.text: They throw things a bit less.

choices.label: Pay them off (15 gold)
choices.text: Grudgingly, they let you go.

choices.label: Run
choices.text: Rotten vegetables everywhere.

events.title: Singing Miners
events.text: A line of dwarf miners marches by, singing a deep song about gold. "Want to buy some coal? Keeps you warm!"

choices.label: Buy coal for the egg (5 gold)
choices.text: You pack hot coal around the egg.

choices.label: Sing along
choices.text: They're delighted and share their lunch.

events.title: The Great Eagle
events.text: A giant eagle lands on a rock beside you and stares at the egg. It looks hungry.

choices.label: Shield the egg
choices.text: Everyone stands around the egg. The eagle gives up and flies away.

choices.label: Offer it food instead
choices.text: It snatches the food and flies off.

choices.label: Griffin friend: whistle
choices.text: Your griffin friend appears and chases the eagle away!

events.title: The Old Mine Rails
events.text: Old mine rails run down the mountain toward where you're going. There's an old mine cart, big enough for everyone.

choices.label: Ride the mine cart!
choices.text: Hold on...

choices.label: Walk
choices.text: Probably wise.

events.title: The Mountain Guardian
events.text: A stone guardian steps out of the cliff. "TELL ME, TRAVELLER, WHAT DO YOU CARRY?"

choices.label: "A dragon egg, going home"
choices.text: "A NOBLE TASK." It steps aside and points to a safer path.

choices.label: "Nothing"
choices.text: "YOU LIE." It blocks the path for an hour, sulking.

events.title: A Lost Pickaxe
events.text: A shiny silver pickaxe lies by the road with dwarf runes on the handle.

choices.label: Take it to the dwarves
choices.text: It belongs to the dwarf king's daughter! You'll be welcome at Ironroot.

choices.label: Sell it
choices.text: It's worth a lot.

events.title: The Bouncy Mushroom
events.text: A giant mushroom as big as a house blocks the road. It's very, very bouncy.

choices.label: Bounce over it
choices.text: BOING! Everyone bounces over, laughing their heads off. The cart, less so.

choices.label: Go around
choices.text: It takes a while.

events.title: The Glowing Pond
events.text: A pond that glows bright pink. Something tells you not to drink it.

win.text: Everyone glows pink for a day, and feels amazing!

lose.text: Everyone glows pink for a day and feels sick.

choices.label: Fill a jar for later
choices.text: It glows beautifully. You can use it as a lantern.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Sensible.

events.title: The Mushroom Sage
events.text: An ancient mushroom with a long white beard sits on a stump. "Ask... me... a... question..."

choices.label: "How do we keep the egg warm?"
choices.text: After an hour: "Sing... to... it." You try it. It works!

choices.label: "What's the fastest way?"
choices.text: After an hour: "Not... asking... mushrooms."

choices.label: "How are you?"
choices.text: It thinks for a long time. "Nobody... ever... asks..." It gives you a mushroom that heals anything.

events.title: Sprite Pranks
events.text: Giggling sprites have tied everyone's bootlaces together while you slept.

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.text: You untie them, laughing. The sprites leave you berries to say sorry.

choices.label: Get grumpy
choices.text: The sprites tie them again. Tighter.

events.title: The Sneezing Spores
events.text: Everyone starts sneezing purple dust. ACHOO!

choices.label: Herbs to stop the sneezing
choices.text: Much better.

choices.label: Sneeze it out
choices.text: ACHOO! It takes all day.

events.title: Sinking Mud
events.text: The cart is sinking into the bog! The back wheels are already under.

win.text: SHLORP. The cart pops free!

lose.text: You save the cart, but lose some food to the bog.

choices.label: Cast Float
choices.text: The cart floats up out of the mud.

choices.label: Use spider silk to haul it
choices.text: The silk is perfect. Out it comes.

events.title: The Bog Hag's Bargain
events.text: A hag made of moss and mud rises from the swamp. "Give me something precious and I'll show you the way out. Or don't, and stay forever."

choices.label: Give her gold (15)
choices.text: "Shiny!" She points to a dry path.

choices.label: Give her a story
choices.text: She loves it so much she cries muddy tears. She shows you the way.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: "Then wander!" You wander. For a whole day.

events.title: The Bogbelly Ferry
events.text: A giant toad floats in the swamp like a boat. A little sign on its back says RIDES: 1 HONEY CAKE.

choices.label: Pay a honey cake
choices.text: The toad gives you a ride across the deepest part of the swamp. Ribbit!

choices.label: Walk
choices.text: Squelch. Squelch. Squelch.

events.title: Leeches
events.text: After wading through a pond, {a} finds three leeches on their leg. Eww.

choices.label: Healer: remove them properly
choices.text: Easy. No harm done.

choices.label: Pull them off
choices.text: Ow. Eww. Ow.

choices.label: Salt them
choices.text: They fall off. You've lost some salted food.

events.title: A Sunken Boat
events.text: An old boat is half sunk in the swamp. Something glints inside.

win.text: A box of old coins and a jar!

lose.text: The boat sinks further. You get soaked for nothing.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Not worth it.

events.title: The Great Wind
events.text: A huge gust of wind blows across the island! Everything that isn't tied down starts to blow away.

choices.label: Tie everything down
choices.text: Good thing you had rope.

choices.label: Grab what you can
choices.text: Some food and gold blow off the edge into the clouds.

choices.label: Hold the egg tight
choices.text: The egg is safe. The cart cover is not.

events.title: The Cloud Garden
events.text: An island covered in strange plants that grow on clouds. The fruit tastes like rain.

choices.label: Pick fruit
choices.text: Delicious and filling.

choices.label: Plant something with Bloom
choices.text: The cloud plants go wild! Fruit everywhere.

events.title: Skywhale Song
events.text: A skywhale rises out of the clouds beside your island, singing a long, deep song. The egg hums along.

choices.label: Listen
choices.text: Everyone is quiet. It's wonderful.

choices.label: Cast Beast Speech
choices.text: The whale sings: "The egg-mother is waiting. Fly true." It nudges your island closer to the next one!

events.title: Sky Pirates!
events.text: A ship with balloon sails drifts alongside. Pirates with goggles swing over on ropes! "Hand over your treasure!"
events.kidsText: A ship with balloon sails drifts alongside. Pirates with goggles swing over on ropes! "Ahoy! Got any snacks?"

win.text: You knock them back to their ship! They sail off shouting.

lose.text: They grab a sack of gold and swing away.

choices.label: Offer to join their crew for the day
choices.text: They're delighted. You sail with them and they drop you off far ahead!

choices.label: Cast Float on their ship
choices.text: Their ship floats up, up and away. Bye!

events.title: Falling Rocks
events.text: Little rocks are breaking off a nearby island and falling past you like rain.

choices.label: Dodge them!
choices.text: Steer!

choices.label: Shelter under a ledge
choices.text: You wait it out.

events.title: Fire Salamanders
events.text: Little orange salamanders crawl out of the cracks in the rock and swarm around the egg, purring.

choices.label: Let them
choices.text: They curl around the egg like a warm blanket.

choices.label: Shoo them
choices.text: They scatter, looking hurt.

events.title: The Last Ambush
events.text: On the last stretch of the Ashen Steps, the grey riders are waiting. Their leader smiles. "You've come all this way. Now hand it over."

win.text: You fight like heroes. The hunters flee down the mountain!

lose.text: They grab the egg and run!

choices.label: Call for Cinderwing
choices.text: You shout her name. A roar shakes the mountain. Cinderwing drops from the sky and the hunters run screaming, never to be seen again.

choices.label: Cast Light to blind them
choices.text: A blinding flash! The hunters stumble off the path and slide all the way down the mountain.

choices.label: Hide in the elf cloak
choices.text: You throw the cloak over the egg and yourselves. They ride right past.

events.title: Choking Smoke
events.text: Thick black smoke rolls down from the crater. It's hard to breathe.

choices.label: Push through holding your breath
choices.text: Coughing and spluttering, you make it.

choices.label: Wait for the wind to change
choices.text: An hour later, it clears.

choices.label: Cast Calm on the mountain
choices.text: Surprisingly, the volcano calms down. The smoke thins.

events.title: Dragon Bones
events.text: Huge white bones lie across the path. An old dragon, long gone. Between the ribs, scales glitter.

choices.label: Pay your respects
choices.text: You stand quietly for a while. The egg glows softly.

choices.label: Take some scales to sell
choices.text: They're worth a lot. The egg goes very still.

events.title: Almost There
events.text: You can see the top of Ember Peak, glowing red in the sunset. The egg is humming loudly now. It knows it's nearly home.

choices.label: Rest one last night
choices.text: Everyone sits together and looks at the stars.

choices.label: Climb through the night
choices.text: You climb through the dark, too excited to sleep.
